transcript: never worry about how many people have applied to a job when you see a job that you're super excited about on LinkedIn and it says over 100 people applied and it was only posted 10 minutes ago this is exactly why it's not relevant posted a job that got 450 applications of those only 10% were in the location listed on the job description of those only 25% have the qualifications we're looking for and only 2.5% which is 11 out of 450 are going to be considered for the role the story do not let that number scary if you qualify apply
